The Barakah Circle

Give every month. Grow every year.

Four quick questions and your sadaqah keeps working — through Ramadan, through emergencies, and through every ordinary day in between.

Small. Consistent. Powerful.


“The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most regular and constant ones even if they are little.” (Bukhari)

A one-time gift answers one moment. A recurring gift answers every moment after it. Your support arrives on the days you remember and the days life gets busy — and it keeps reaching families long after the headlines move on.

Barakah that doesn’t stop

Your giving continues through Ramadan, the last ten nights, Dhul Hijjah and every week in between — without a single reminder.

Your gift goes further

Regular income lets our field teams plan ahead, commit to longer projects and reach families early — instead of waiting to see what comes in.

Always in your control

Change your amount, switch causes, pause or cancel at any time. Every gift is receipted, with a single tax summary at the end of the year.

“Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over?”

Qur’an 2:245

Questions, answered

Can I cancel or change my gift?

Yes — any time, with no notice period. Sign in to your account to change the amount, switch cause, pause, or cancel, or call our team on 877-225-2251 and we’ll do it for you.

When will I be charged?

Monthly gifts are taken on the same date each month, starting the day you sign up. Annual gifts are taken once a year on the anniversary of your first gift. You’ll get an email receipt every time.

Can I pay my Zakat this way?

Yes. Anything given to the Zakat Fund is treated as Zakat and distributed only to those eligible under the eight categories. You can also mark most other causes as Zakat at question three.

Is my donation tax-deductible?

Human Appeal Inc. is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 87-2410117. Your gifts are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law, and we send a consolidated summary at the end of each tax year.

What happens if a payment fails?

We’ll email you and retry the payment. Nothing is cancelled straight away — you’ll have the chance to update your card first.

How is this different from The Jummah Club?

The Jummah Club gives every Friday. The Barakah Circle gives every month or once a year. Same causes, different rhythm — and you’re welcome to join both. See The Jummah Club.

Human Appeal Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 87-2410117.
Questions about recurring giving? Call 877-225-2251, 11am–8pm CST.

Make it a habit, not a decision.

Give once and it ends. Give every month and it doesn’t.
